sleight_of_hand.name: Sleight of Hand
sleight_of_hand.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Bluff gives +2 on Sleight of Hand checks to palm small objects.

actions.name: Pick Pocket or Cut Purse
actions.description: Lift a coin pouch or small bauble off an unaware target without them realizing the theft.

actions.name: Palm Small Object or Dagger
actions.description: Slip a coin, key, or concealed light blade up a sleeve or behind a palm.
